convert_sync_function_to_async: convert a synchronous function to an async function using convert_to_async with a thread or process executor
convert_sync_generator_to_async_gen: convert a synchronous generator function to an async generator using convert_to_async for pipeline operations
check_executor_is_process_pool: check if an executor is a ProcessPoolExecutor using _is_process_pool to determine subprocess execution strategy
run_function_in_subprocess_with_error_co: run a function in a subprocess with enhanced error context using _func_in_subprocess for debugging
convert_generator_to_batch_async: convert a sync generator to a batch async generator using _to_batch_async_gen for process pool execution
